description: This file defines the ToolbarController class for the Drupal toolbar module, including methods for AJAX responses, access checks, and rendering the administration tray and subtrees.

classes.name: ToolbarController
classes.description: Controller class for managing toolbar-related AJAX responses, access control, and rendering in Drupal.

methods.name: subtreesAjax
methods.description: Returns an AJAX response with rendered toolbar subtrees and cache headers.

methods.name: checkSubTreeAccess
methods.description: Checks user permission and hash validity for toolbar subtrees access.

methods.name: preRenderAdministrationTray
methods.description: Pre-render callback to load and build the administrative menu tray.

methods.name: preRenderGetRenderedSubtrees
methods.description: Pre-render callback to load, transform, and cache toolbar subtrees.

methods.name: trustedCallbacks
methods.description: Returns list of callback functions for trusted rendering.
